|lore=Pilot DS-61-3. Vader's right wingman. Flies Black 3. Reputation for ferocity in combat. Corellian pilot with excellent skills. Nicknamed 'Backstabber.'
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a dreadnaught or starfighter, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and opponent's immunity to attrition here is limited to &lt; 7 (&lt; 5 if piloting Black 3 or with Vader). Your non-[Coruscant] Interrupts with 'back' in title are destiny +2.
